scripted_metric.init_script: state.m = new HashMap(); state.top = new ArrayList();
scripted_metric.map_script: String d = doc['did'].value; long t = doc['time_us'].value; long[] e = state.m.get(d); if (e == null) { e = new long[] {t, t}; state.m.put(d, e); } else { if (t < e[0]) { e[0] = t; } if (t > e[1]) { e[1] = t; } } long s = e[1] - e[0]; if (state.top.size() < 3 || s > state.top.get(state.top.size() - 1).span) { List n = new ArrayList(); for (def x : state.top) { if (x.did != d) { n.add(x); } } n.add(['did': d, 'span': s]); n.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.span, a.span)); state.top = n.size() > 3 ? new ArrayList(n.subList(0, 3)) : n; }
scripted_metric.reduce_script: List all = new ArrayList(); for (def s : states) { if (s != null) { all.addAll(s); } } all.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.span, a.span)); List r = new ArrayList(); for (def x : all) { if (r.size() < 3) { r.add(['user_id': x.did, 'activity_span_ms': x.span / 1000]); } } return r;
